payload.claim: The spec's own "Measured on a prototype" note states 167 changed tokens outside tests/** and 1095 with the tests, but this same backlog item's docs/evidence/2026-11-10-spec-chain-feedback.md (committed in this same snapshot) records a different combined figure: "With the tests counted, check prices 1332 tokens against a ceiling of 1300 and would split." The two logged measurements for the same diff disagree. This has no effect on whether the cell's diff passes the size gate, since size_gate excludes tokens under the declared test_paths (tests/**, per .saffron/policy.yaml:70), so only the 167-token figure is actually enforced against the 1300 bug ceiling, and that is safely under it either way.
